# AegisFlow Enterprise — Business Rules & Core Specification

Enterprise change management requires strict multi-tenant isolation, automated risk-based approval tier routing, tamper-evident audit trails, and deterministic governance to prevent unauthorized or unvetted modifications to critical business infrastructure.
